admission.justification: The constructor value is checked by the leaf-handover tests over the three eligible and four protected roles.

applicability: Every Worker, Reviewer, Curator or Consolidator handover the launch constructor compiles for a canonical leaf.
conditions: The value names the leaf's admitted seat roles (three seats on ordinary leaves or two seats on consolidation leaves) and sibling role_message arguments with canonical master and leaf references, and the sprint reference when the selection has one.
No sibling agent id is listed, because the occupant can change.
exclusions: Other roles and non-leaf launches receive no leafSeats peer block; unrelated values stay preserved, except approved message carrier and parent-role/task return metadata.
Native launch-parent identity, actual-parent-ID developer questions and independent seat authority are not changed by replacement-transparent report returns.

evidence: Current successor r2/candidate-freeze.json, repair-report.md, commands.json and compiled capsule/constructor/81 retirement controls; predecessor inventory.md and actual live-witness/witness-supplement.md retained. Historical A1 evidence (not current disposition): Retained constructor-preservation.json: seven same-input comparisons, all other values identical; static-final-bytes.log and affected-final-pass.log passed.

statement: Only a leaf Worker, Reviewer, Curator or Consolidator handover gains leafSeats with the leaf's seat roles (Worker, Reviewer and Curator on ordinary leaves; Consolidator and Reviewer on consolidation leaves) and exact sibling role-message arguments containing canonical master and leaf references, and the sprint reference when the selection has one, without sibling agent IDs.
